verdict.rationale: Latham & Watkins offers LathamDrive, a web platform with a document generator, so data portability is a fair question to ask. However, nothing in the evidence documents a way to export a user's data in open formats or to migrate away. The Book of Jargon PDF is published reference content, not an export of user data, so it does not count.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
